message.content: {"8": {"original": "BitTorrent is a peer-to-peer file distribution tool written by programmer Bram C", "rephrased": "The BitTorrent system, developed by programmer Bram Cohen and introduced in 2002, functions as a peer-to-peer file distribution tool that allows users to swap file portions with one another rather than relying on a single centralised server, a design that supports the rapid distribution of new files to large numbers of users across Europe and globally.", "summary": "BitTorrent is a 2002 peer-to-peer tool designed for rapid, decentralized file distribution."}, "9": {"original": "eDonkey2000 is a peer-to-peer file sharing application using the Multisource F", "rephrased": "The eDonkey2000 network, developed by the company MetaMachine using the Multisource File Transfer Protocol, operates as a peer-to-peer file sharing application that encourages permanent sharing to ensure long-term availability, though it is generally less effective than the BitTorrent system in quickly spreading new releases to large user groups.", "summary": "MetaMachine's eDonkey2000 is a peer-to-peer sharing app prioritizing long-term availability over rapid new release distribution."}}
